Learned.Note: A meta-model learned these weights from history (walk-forward, out-of-sample) instead of us setting them by hand. The accuracy shown is that of the learned combination itself — on synthetic data it correctly stays near chance.
RegimeWeight.Note: The weights are those a meta-model learned for the regime this symbol is in NOW; a different set applies in other regimes. Accuracy is a regime-routed walk-forward — each past bar judged by its own regime's model — so it stays out-of-sample.
Calibration.Note: Each grade's signals are re-generated on historical bars the model never trained on, then scored by whether they hit target before stop. When predicted ≈ realized, the grade is honest. On synthetic data every grade correctly lands near ~50%: there is no real edge to find.
Registry.Note: Live tally of signals this system actually emitted and later resolved. It only accumulates forward, so it starts empty and grows as real outcomes land — the honest, unfalsifiable proof of edge.
